rationale: The answer is a high-quality architecture review that meets the user's request. It states scope and confidence explicitly, distinguishes facts from inference, and treats documentation as secondary evidence — correctly catching the CLAUDE.md sandbox note (contextIsolation:false/nodeIntegration:true) that contradicts config.ts and the context-isolation E2E canary. All load-bearing claims were verified: sandbox config (config.ts:11-19), contextBridge facades (preload/index.ts), WindowManager owning the watcher and EditorWindow holding _openedFiles/_openedRootDirectory and emitting watcher-* channels via ipcMain.emit, atomic durable writes (filesystem/index.ts write-file-atomic + fsync), IFileState mixing cursor/blocks/history/functions/unknowns, ipc.ts unknowns/unprefixed channels/dynamic response channel (mt::response-of-image-path-${id}), dual muyajs/@muyajs/core deps with handwritten muya-core.d.ts, renderer @muyajs/core imports and editor.vue synthetic history/selection/source-mode work, PG14 remaining test.fail() (PARITY_SCOREBOARD.md:69), tabs.spec.ts reaching Pinia internals, no dedicated multi-window E2E spec, CI paths-ignore on packages/muya/** plus muya's own test/spec/e2e/circular workflows, and the c907b29c last-keystroke regression. The historical SHAs other than c907b29c could not be independently replayed with the available read-only tools, but their substantive claims are consistent with current code and comments (#3786/#3828 durable save, crash-recovery buffer). Two minor errors: the answer attributes `src/muya` to CLAUDE.md (it is in ARCHITECTURE.md/TYPESCRIPT.md, not CLAUDE.md), and a few line-number anchors are off by a handful of lines. Neither changes the recommendation. The two documentation drifts (sandbox note conflict, legacy src/muya structure historical) are both non-decision-relevant because the answer identified them and relied on implementation evidence. Recommendation B (narrow facades, keep sandbox boundaries, defer workspace/plugin abstractions) follows from the evidence, with A (status quo) and C (centralized workspace) as viable alternatives, explicit tradeoffs/cost/risk/rollback, and a verifiable incremental migration path.
